{{Top|leg}}
'''Vros''' were small [[Fish/Legends|fish]] found only in the southern oceans of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. They were a favorite food of Cularin's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]], who had sauteed vros served at the celebrations for her election as senator.
